Workshop · Saturday 14 November

The Menopause Blueprintfor your body and your nerves.

A morning with Helen on what perimenopause and menopause do to your joints, bones and muscles, and to your nervous system, with practical things you can do about it. Part talk, part movement, with a break in the middle for food and questions.

Text or call Helen to bookSend a message

Saturday 14 November, 10am to 1:30pm. £60. Text Helen on 07718 339510

How the morning runs

10am to 11:15am

Part one: menopause and the body

What the change through perimenopause and menopause does to your joints, bones and muscles, and how to support your body through it. Then a strengthening flow: functional mobility for the joints and some deep work for the core and pelvic floor.

11:15am to 12 noon

Break

Something good to eat and time to ask questions. Helen will be on hand to talk through which Heat Fitness classes would suit you best.

12 noon to 1:30pm

Part two: menopause and the nervous system

How hormonal shifts can affect your mood and your response to stress, and simple somatic tools to check in with your nervous system day by day. Then a nourishing somatic yin class, finishing with a guided yoga nidra and breathwork.

Is this for you?

  • You're in perimenopause or menopause, or you think you might be
  • Your joints, sleep, mood or energy have changed and you'd like to understand why
  • You'd like practical things to do, not just information
  • You're curious about our six-week groups and want to meet Helen first

The details

Saturday 14 November10am to 1:30pm£60

At Heat Fitness, Unit 22, 15 Borrowmeadow Road, Stirling FK7 7FB. Wear comfortable clothes and bring a bottle of water. Mats and props are provided.

Text Helen to book

Want to keep going afterwards? Have a look at Strong and Calm (perimenopause) and Strong Bones (menopause and after).

Questions

Do I need to be fit or have done yoga before?

No. Everything in the movement parts can be done gently, and Helen will show you options to suit your body on the day.

Is this medical advice?

No. It's education, movement and support. Please speak to your GP about any symptoms that worry you, or about treatment such as HRT.

How do I book?

Text or call Helen on 07718 339510, or send a message, and she'll confirm your place.
